connector.name: Chad Analytics
connector.registryDescription: Read-only website analytics, AI referrals, crawlers, goals, revenue, and funnels.
connector.summary: Hosted at chadanalytics.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.chadanalytics, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
